result.title: Nonlinear Maps Between Irreducible Representations in Graph Neural Networks
result.summary: Equivariant linear maps cannot mix non-isomorphic irreducible representations, whereas nonlinear activations can. We develop a degree-resolved version of this nonlinear interaction picture and use the resulting block inventory to construct Specht Triple, a residual on unordered graph triples. On a synthetic structural benchmark with a frozen GIN backbone, Specht Triple reduces aggregate standardised test MSE by 11.05% relative to a parameter-matched Projector Control using the same irreducible projectors and complete linear equivariant space. The results support irreducible decomposition as an inductive bias for nonlinear higher-order equivariant processing.

AI.brief_summary: 论文给出等变网络中不可约表示之间非线性交互的按次数（degree-resolved）分解，并据此构造作用于无序图三元组的 Specht Triple 残差，在冻结 GIN 主干的合成结构基准上将标准化测试 MSE 相对参数匹配对照降低 11.05%。
AI.relevance_reason: 不可约分解与非线性混合的「块清单」或可作为刻画 latent 推理状态表示几何、区分哪些信息被保留的候选分析框架，但与 VLM 推理关联较远，需核查可迁移性。
